remarks: Experience vibrant city living in this stunning 1-bedroom condo, filled with natural light, beautiful hardwood floors, and sweeping views of downtown Stamford. The open-concept layout features large windows, engineered hardwood floors throughout, and a modern kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast bar that flows seamlessly into the living/dining area-perfect for entertaining. The bright and airy primary bedroom offers multiple windows, a generous spacious closet, and easy access to the full bath. An in-unit washer/dryer adds convenience, while efficient HVAC systems provide year-round comfort.    At The Windemere, enjoy premium amenities including secure entry, assigned garage parking, an elevator, a newly renovated fitness center, and a private patio area with BBQ grills-ideal for outdoor gatherings. All of this is just a short walk to Stamford's best restaurants, shops, nightlife, and transportation.
